8th OCT. 1983 BROCKWELL PARK SCWAAA ROAD RELAY Good running from all concerned, especially from Jackie Stone. Unfortunately, we were unable to field an inter or Senior team.
As usual Jackie Stone and Rosemary Honeychurch ran well and a special mention for Davina Cameron who is always in there trying hard and grafting away.
For various reasons we finally finished with only 3 girls and unfortunately Jackie Stone dropped out leaving Christina Gauge and Rachael Parrott to battle it out with the hoards of Mitcham girls.

Not as many running as last year and a time trial run by Rosemary Honeychurch spirited runs up at the front with a good battle between Jackie Stone and Davina Cameron and between Isobel Young and Christina Gauge.

We were a bit short of junior middle distance runners, but those who did the events tried their best but the improvement shown by Jackie Stone was very encouraging as well as winning Silver in the Surrey Championships.
A good run in the Girls from Jackie Stone and the Seniors and Inters pulled out all the stops to record our first win in this League and Rosemary was our first individual winner.
